_note: recommended per-lane confidence floors measured in bench/oos_eval_catalog.json (mtlm-router). null = argmax abstain carries the lane, no useful floor. Re-measure on head/corpus change.

helpdesk.note: argmax abstains 100% of held-out OOS; no floor needed
helpdesk.qhat_note: selective-risk on 160-row cal split (holdout_helpdesk 300 + oos_eval 20, halved): helpdesk_v2_mt → 98.1% auto, ub95 1.89%, eval err 0%; helpdesk_pool_L-3_mean → 93.8% auto, ub95 3.10%, eval err 0%. Both hosted aliases (helpdesk2, it_helpdesk) wired at qhat 0.95.
helpdesk.mondrian: per-class qhat α=0.05: v2 96.2% auto (worst-class 88%); pool head 90.6% but worst-class 0% — one route never reaches singletons under class-conditional coverage
limitations: 7-class taxonomy incl. oos — out-of-taxonomy queries correctly resolve to oos/escalate

civic.qhat_note: selective-risk α=0.05 on 566-row eval / 565 cal (civic_holdout+civic_oos): 67.7% auto, ub95 bound 3.45%, eval err 2.09% — vs old floor-0.5's 96.8% auto at 10% unbounded err
civic.mondrian: per-class qhat: auto 46.1% at α=0.05 — narrow 14-route lane sustains real class-conditional automation
limitations: 14-class narrow lane — genuine per-class automation viable (46%)

civic_fr.note: confidence ~1.0 everywhere; gating cannot discriminate, argmax abstain carries it
civic_fr.qhat_note: v3w head (v2 corpus + 110 natural-phrasing rows x4 weight): conformal on 352-row cal split, alpha=0.02 -> qhat 0.746. Holdout: 96.7% auto, err_auto 0.31%, coverage 99.7%. Natural eval (22 phrasings): auto 86.4%, err 5.26%, coverage 95.5%. vs v2 head: natural_eval 7/22 -> 22/22 (route-or-candidate).
civic_fr.mondrian: per-class qhat: auto 89.2% at α=0.05, worst-class 78.6% (12 classes) — narrow taxonomy sustains real class-conditional automation, the standout lane
civic_fr.golden_note: RESOLVED 2026-10-13: confident-oos singleton on 'lampadaire en panne' was a corpus-narrowness defect, NOT a prompt mismatch (v2 features were already DECIDE_SYS). Fixed by training civic_fr_v3w_mt.head with 110 hand-written natural phrasings across all 11 classes; deployed to prod 8402, golden probe now eclairage@1.00. Bank77's 'lost my card'->oos is CORRECT scope rejection (bank50 subset lacks lost_or_stolen_card).
limitations: synthetic corpus: in-scope numbers reflect template separability, not production skill
natural_eval measures only 22 phrasings; wider natural coverage unmeasured
best-calibrated lane under mondrian (89% per-class auto, 97.7% marginal)

clinc150.note: 7.8% leak / 69% coverage at 0.7; 15-20% argmax abstain is weak, the floor is the gate
clinc150.qhat_note: selective-risk α=0.05 on 2766-row cal split (clinc_holdout+hn_eval): auto 46.5% (v1) / 46.2% (v2), ub95 bound ~4.5-4.8%, eval err ~3.9%. Both hosted aliases (clinc, clinc2) wired at qhat 0.95. Caveat: cal split nearly all in-scope — bound covers routing errors, not OOS recall.
clinc150.mondrian: per-class qhat: auto 4.7% at α=0.05 — wide taxonomies route through clarification sets, not singletons; confusion is local though — 72.6% of multi-sets fall inside one co-occurrence cluster (tools/set_cluster.py, qhat 0.95): a coarse→fine hierarchy could automate at parent level for most abstains; bank77 contrast: 100% one cluster, no hierarchical rescue
limitations: 151 classes: mondrian auto ~4-5%; candidates[] clarification is the primary interaction mode
cal split had ~32 oos rows — the bound covers routing errors, not oos recall

eq_tone.note: HEAD CALIBRATION WARNING (eq_test 4995-row eval, helpdesk_v2 head=eq_tone_v2): confidence nearly uninformative — floor 0.5 → 62.7% auto at 39.4% error; floor 0.9 → 5.6% auto at 1.4% err. No selective-risk conformal point meets α≤0.05; best is α=0.10 at qhat 0.10 → 5.6% auto ≤8.0% bound. Hosted minconf raised 0.5→0.9 (was the most dangerous lane). Needs retrain/recalibration, not a threshold.
eq_tone.mondrian: per-class auto 7.4% at α=0.05, worst-class 0.9% (5 classes) — the head cannot discriminate within classes either
limitations: miscalibrated at runtime: features were extracted under a non-decide_sys prompt (train/serve mismatch); retrain in flight 2026-10-12
interim minconf 0.9 — automates only ~5.6% of traffic; treat as triage signal

banking77.qhat_note: conformal α=0.10 on 1398-row cal split (test+id-oos mix): 46.4% auto, 9.1% err among auto, 88.3% set coverage — replaces the 0.7 floor where wired
banking77.mondrian: per-class qhat: auto collapses to 0.6% at α=0.05 — marginal auto rate is subsidized by easy classes; expect candidates[] on most traffic
limitations: bank50 subset: only 50 of banking77's 77 classes — queries for absent classes (e.g. lost_or_stolen_card) correctly return oos

idoos training set contains ~734 'card'-mentioning rows labeled oos that overlap real card classes (e.g. card-arrival phrasings) — contaminates card-* classes; retrain-with-relabeling would raise card-class recall
clarification-first lane: per-class conformal automation near zero; candidates[] is the terminal UX
